name: El Greco
findings: Uses smoky black 1.9x more than the other paintings from the same museum(s), so camera and varnish are held equal (from 820 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, marine blue turns up as a small accent in 40% of the paintings that hold it, 5.8x the archive's rate (from 820 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, dim grey turns up as the lightest note in 64% of the paintings that hold it, 3.2x the archive's rate (from 820 paintings here).
Pairs cement grey with slate-olive more than chance would predict (3 of 820 paintings here).
Pairs bluish grey with cool grey more than chance would predict (3 of 820 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, black, raisin black) covers 64% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from smoky black, black to smoky black, dark olive brown.
Paints most like Johannes Vermeer among the painters in this archive, by palette.
